Help and questions

How fast is delivery?

Order by 10pm for free next-day delivery on orders over $49. Standard delivery takes 2 to 3 working days.

What does the price match promise mean?

If you find the same product cheaper at a major retailer within 14 days, we'll refund the difference.

How do I return a product?

Start a return from your account within 30 days. We send a free label and refund you as soon as it arrives.

Do you sell refurbished products?

Yes. Our certified refurbished range is tested, cleaned and comes with the same 2-year warranty.
